label: preparing
what: A secret jubilee feast celebrating the mayor's forty years of service, scheduled for day 1 at 18:00 in the great hall, with 200 fresh loaves and eight lanterns. Innkeeper, freight and builder coordinated supplies, baking, delivery, lighting and a lighting-inspection cover appointment; baker knowingly supplied bread and credit, and neighbour knowingly agreed to escort the mayor while preserving the surprise. The mayor learned of the inspection and some bread deliveries, but the record does not show the jubilee being disclosed. No evidence establishes that secretary knowingly helped the secret celebration.
